response.rationale: Sturge-Weber syndrome is supported by the facial erythema (forehead/eyelid) and capillary malformations, with abnormal mucosal enhancement suggesting vascular involvement; PHACE is less specific without posterior fossa anomalies, and Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber lacks limb hypertrophy.

rejected.why: No limb hypertrophy or varicosities typical of Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber; only nonspecific capillary malformations.
PHACE requires posterior fossa malformations or arterial anomalies, which are absent; cardiac defect alone is insufficient.
